responsibility: This file provides the AArch64 hooks for C-family front ends: it defines and updates target preprocessor macros, handles AArch64-specific pragmas, and routes overloaded builtin resolution and call checking to the appropriate backend subsystems. It owns the TARGET_CPU_CPP_BUILTINS logic for ACLE and ISA feature macros, updates those macros when #pragma GCC target changes backend state, implements the #pragma GCC aarch64 dispatcher used by arm_acle.h, arm_neon.h, and arm_sve.h, and installs the target hooks that forward general and SVE overloaded builtin handling into the backend builtin implementations.
